sentence: そいつらが酒やら女やら欲しがって

official: They come thirsty for booze and women

sentence: なんだよ、不器用なりに一応わかってんじゃねえか。
literal: What, so in your clumsy way you actually get it after all, huh.
official: When did you start waxing poetic? Not that you're wrong.

sentence: 見直したか？
literal: So, changed your opinion of me now?
official: You impressed?

sentence: フッ、なんだよ、俺のいうこと疑ってる？
literal: Heh, what's this, you doubting what I'm telling you?
official: What, you don't trust me?

sentence: うーん、信じたいけどなぁ。
literal: Hmm, I'd like to believe you, but...
official: Well, I WANT to...

sentence: そんなこと言うなよぉ。……ほら、お小遣いだ。
literal: Aw, don't say that. ...Here, a little pocket money for you.
official: Aw, don't be like that. Here, buy yourselves something nice.

sentence: 今夜はとことん付き合ってもらうからな。
literal: You're keeping me company all the way tonight, got it.
official: Hope you're ready, because I'm not stopping till morning.

sentence: （どうやら俺はハメられたらしい……
literal: (Seems like I've been set up...)
official: (It looks like that loan shark set me up.)

sentence: （どういうカラクリになっているのか……
literal: (Just what kind of scheme is going on here...)
official: (I don't know what his game is...)

sentence: オー！　ボーイ！
literal: Oh! Boy!
official: Hey, boy!

sentence: おうジジイ……　この兄ちゃんがそうか？
literal: Hey, geezer... this the young guy you meant?
official: Alright, gramps... Is this the kid?

sentence: ……まさか、その１００万、
literal: ...Don't tell me, that one million yen—
official: ...Wait, you don't expect ME to pay, do you?

sentence: ふざけんな。
literal: Don't screw with me.
official: Like hell they are!

sentence: 怪我する前にカネ出しておいた方が身のためだぜ？
literal: You'd best cough up the cash before you get hurt—for your own good, y'know?
official: For your own sake, I'd pay up before I got hurt.

sentence: 面倒な話に巻き込むんじゃねぇ。
literal: Don't drag me into your troublesome mess.
official: You're not going to drag me into your problems.

sentence: つまり、自信は無いんだネ？
literal: In other words, you're not confident, are you?
official: Oh, so you think he'd beat you.

sentence: ……そうやって俺を焚きつけようとしても無駄だぜ。
literal: ...Trying to goad me on like that won't get you anywhere.
official: ...Look, if you're trying to bait me, it's not going to work.

sentence: テメェの借金はテメェで払え。
literal: Pay your own damn debt yourself.
official: It's your debt, you handle it.

sentence: セカイにはあんなのがゴロゴロいるんデスヨ？
literal: There are tons of guys like that all over the world, you know?
official: He's bargain-bin muscle. Dime a dozen.

sentence: オーケイ、ワカリマシタ！
literal: Okay, understood!
official: Okay, all right!

sentence: お前ら３人が束になっても勝てやしねぇぞ？
literal: Even if the three of you gang up, you haven't got a chance, you know?
official: All three of you could rush him at the same time and he'd snap you like twigs.

sentence: 言っとくが俺は手伝うつもりはねえからな。
literal: I'm telling you up front, I've got no intention of helping.
official: I'll tell you right now I'm not bailing you out.

sentence: カモジ君はチョットガンバルだけネ。
literal: Kamoji here is just gonna try a little, okay.
official: He'll be fine. Just a little workout.

sentence: シロウトが無理するもんじゃねぇ。
literal: An amateur shouldn't push his luck.
official: You shouldn't push yourself like that.

sentence: 向こうのパンチ、全然ヒットしてないネ。
literal: The other guy's punches aren't landing at all, huh.
official: Big guy didn't land a single punch on him.

sentence: おい、そこのホームレス！
literal: Hey, you—the homeless guy over there!
official: Hey, you in the coat. Homeless dude!

sentence: そのヘナチョコパンチでまだやるのか？
literal: You're gonna keep going with those wimpy little punches?
official: You gonna try to finish the job with those weak-ass punches?

sentence: フッ……　しょうがねえな。
literal: Heh... Well, guess there's no helping it.
official: Heh... Yeah, all right.

sentence: これっぽっちもやる気なんてなかったが、
literal: I didn't have the slightest bit of motivation for this, but...
official: I meant it when I said I wouldn't bail you out,

sentence: アイツの技見ちまったら気が変わったぜ……
literal: After seeing that guy's moves, though, I changed my mind...
official: but watching him just put me in the mood for a quick round.

sentence: ブル野、やっちまえ！
literal: Bruno, let 'em have it!
official: Bruno? Take him!

sentence: な……　ブル野がこんな一方的に……
literal: Wh... Bruno's getting beaten this one-sidedly...
official: What just happened? Bruno barely got a punch in!

sentence: テメェ、一体何者なんだ？
literal: The hell—just who are you, anyway?
official: Just who the hell ARE you?

sentence: え、あ、本職の方だったんですか……!?
literal: H-huh... So you were one of the real deal (an actual yakuza)...?!
official: Whoa, wait, you're a proper yakuza!?

sentence: 俺らは、いや、僕達は東興クレジットの者です。
literal: We're—no, I mean, we're with Toko Credit.
official: We just work for Toko Credit.

sentence: 東興クレジットか……　丁度いい。
literal: Toko Credit, huh... That works out nicely.
official: Well there's a coincidence.

sentence: それなら、今はオフィスにいるかと思います。
literal: In that case, I'd think he's at the office right now.
official: The president? I figure he'd be at the office at this hour.

sentence: ……ワタシの借金、これでチャラ？
literal: ...My debt—it's cleared with this, right?
official: And that takes care of that little debt of ours, right?

sentence: それがキリトリのルールです。
literal: That's the rule of debt collection (kiritori).
official: That's how our kinda debt collection works.

sentence: 何の目的があって俺に近づいて来てるんだ？
literal: What's your aim in getting close to me?
official: Why approach me? What are you after?

sentence: 何か事情があるなら全部話してくれ。
literal: If there's some reason behind it, tell me the whole story.
official: Look, if you're in some trouble, tell me.

sentence: ……あのカモジって男にしてもそうだ。
literal: ...The same goes for that guy called Kamoji.
official: And that goes for him, too.

sentence: ただのホームレスにしちゃ、動きが素人じゃない。

official: Those weren't the moves of an amateur.

sentence: 客から参加料をもらって、

official: The customer pays a fee,

sentence: たくさんのエッセンス持ってるヨ！

official: Kamoji-kun here's got plenty to teach you about fighting, my boy.

sentence: ボーイは見なきゃ損するネ！
literal: You'd be missing out if you don't watch, boy!
official: You'll kick yourself if you don't check it out.

sentence: 七福パークだな？　時間が出来た時に行くぜ。
literal: Shichifuku Park, right? I'll head over when I get the time.
official: Shichifuku Parking Lot, right? I'll swing by if I can find the time.

sentence: 実はネ、向こうから来るコワーい顔したメンズと
literal: Actually, y'know, with those scary-faced men coming over there—
official: I just need you to talk to a couple guys. They'll be here real soon. They'll also be real angry.

sentence: 師匠の借金は弟子が払うものネ。
literal: It's the pupil who pays the master's debts.
official: Besides, the debts of the master are the debts of... y'know, you.

sentence: へへ、“現役女子大生ホステス”の
literal: Heheh, of the "active current college-girl hostesses"—
